candidate.title: Spatial transcriptomic landscape unveils immunoglobin-associated senescence as a hallmark of aging.
candidate.abstract: To systematically characterize the loss of tissue integrity and organ dysfunction resulting from aging, we produced an in-depth spatial transcriptomic profile of nine tissues in male mice during aging. We showed that senescence-sensitive spots (SSSs) colocalized with elevated entropy in organizational structure and that the aggregation of immunoglobulin-expressing cells is a characteristic feature of the microenvironment surrounding SSSs. Immunoglobulin G (IgG) accumulated across the aged tissues in both male and female mice, and a similar phenomenon was observed in human tissues, suggesting the potential of the abnormal elevation of immunoglobulins as an evolutionarily conserved feature in aging. Furthermore, we observed that IgG could induce a pro-senescent state in macrophages and microglia, thereby exacerbating tissue aging, and that targeted reduction of IgG mitigated aging across various tissues in male mice. This study provides a high-resolution spatial depiction of aging and indicates the pivotal role of immunoglobulin-associated senescence during the aging process.

panel.reason: 空间转录组衰老图谱，多组织数据资源，契合空间衰老方向
Cell空间转录组衰老图谱，多组织，免疫球蛋白衰老新标志

extraction.method: 空间转录组解析小鼠九组织衰老图谱
extraction.data: 雄性小鼠9种组织衰老空间转录组
extraction.scenario: 组织衰老与免疫球蛋白相关衰老
extraction.benchmark: 年轻 vs 年老组织；雄性与雌性小鼠及人组织
extraction.results: IgG在衰老组织积累；IgG诱导巨噬/小胶质促衰老；降低IgG缓解小鼠多组织衰老
extraction.limitations: 全文未公开；以雄性小鼠为主；机制与人类因果性仍需验证
extraction.summary: 研究构建衰老组织的高分辨率空间转录组图谱。作者对雄性小鼠9种组织进行衰老空间转录组分析，并结合雌性小鼠和人类组织验证。发现免疫球蛋白表达细胞聚集和IgG积累是衰老保守特征，IgG可诱导巨噬细胞和小胶质细胞促衰老，靶向降低IgG可缓解小鼠多组织衰老。
